item.title: Declassified CIA Cartography Maps from the 1980s
item.description:
📝 1980 Central Moscow Map This 1980 CIA map of Moscow is a detailed urban intelligence map focused on the center of the Soviet capital during the late Cold War. By 1980, Moscow was under intense scrutiny from Western intelligence agencies. These geographic divisions often overlapped with ethnic and political boundaries, something intelligence analysts closely monitored.
🔗 Read more: https://brilliantmaps.com/cia-maps-1980s/

item.title: Go: Support for Generic Methods
item.description:
📝 2022) So far we have resisted adding generic concrete methods because it always implied that we also needed generic interface methods. If a concrete method is a function with a receiver, a generic concrete method can be a generic function with a receiver. Proposal We propose that concrete method declarations should look exactly like function declarations, but with receivers.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/golang/go/issues/77273
